place: Soi Lam Sai, Karon, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, Thailand
title: Villa Zai — 11-Bedroom Clifftop Estate, Kata
blurb: A modern 11-bedroom hillside hideaway on a headland between Kata and Karon — panoramic sea views, an infinity pool and jacuzzi, cinema, spa, gym, pickleball court and putting green, with a 16-strong staff for up to 24 guests.
detail:
Situated on a headland on Phuket's west coast between the beaches of Kata and Karon, Villa Zai is a luxurious modern hillside hideaway. The 11-bedroom property is designed with special attention to open spaces and indoor-to-outdoor elegance, with panoramic sea and sunset views, blending privacy with sophistication for guests who enjoy the finer things in life.

The expansive living room seats 20 against a backdrop of sea views and includes a billiards table convertible for table tennis, while a nearby dining room offers a terrace for all-day dining, a private bar, a wine cellar and a poker table. The outdoor lounge invites guests to take in the scenery, and the infinity pool and jacuzzi are perfect for swims and soaks overlooking the hillside, alongside a generous sun deck and a large rooftop.

There's no shortage of things to do: an in-villa spa with a steam room, a golf putting green, an outdoor pickleball court, a fully-equipped gym, a cinema room and a karaoke and games room with ping pong. With capacity for up to 24 guests across 11 bedrooms — and a 16-strong staff with private parking for 20 cars — Villa Zai is built for families, friends and large groups celebrating in style.

The rate includes two-way airport transfers on the same flight, a welcome drink, cold towel and fruit baskets on arrival, wireless internet access and turndown service, with a full-time team — villa manager, chefs and housekeepers — at your service throughout the stay. The chef handles all grocery shopping and meal preparation (a 20% handling fee applies to grocery cost, subject to 7% VAT), and broader guest-experience services can be arranged on request.

A refundable security deposit of US$5,000 is required in any currency, payable by credit card two days before arrival.
